The MI cause is recorded as stated (verification unknown); the PE trigger is review_only.

The timeline table and the narrative each name a single right heart catheterization with identical values; the table adds the time "2 months" and the narrative adds the units, so they are one catheterization. The Day 2 bubble echocardiogram and the 80 m / 411 m 6-min walk test values are likewise one test each, named in both the table and the text.
A pulmonary pressure of 47 mmHg is reported before pulmonary endarterectomy without naming the pressure type, while the earlier catheterization reports a mean pulmonary arterial pressure of 33 mmHg.

The timeline table lists intracoronary tPA followed by a systemic intravenous dose, then (Subsequently) aspiration, whereas the narrative states the full tPA protocol was completed intravenously in the paragraph describing the CT pulmonary angiogram. Whether these are one intravenous administration and when it was given relative to aspiration and CTPA is not established.
The discussion states right ventricular infarction and inferior infarction were considered adverse in "our case", but no right ventricular infarction is individually documented in the case narrative.
The timeline table "Initial presentation (Day 1)" cell spans four rows (rowspan=4): coronary angiography, tPA and aspiration, and CTPA are placed on Day 1 by that spanning time cell, at event level.
